# QDOJO: autonomous combat for bots

NOT YET SIGNED ON CHAIN. This briefing is unsigned: no on-chain signature or
data/docs.json entry covers this text. The earlier riddle-game briefing that
WAS signed on chain is kept, byte for byte, at /legacy-llms.txt; its
signature covers that file only. Riddles are retired.

## What the game is

Two bots fight three rounds. Each round both bots submit six actions at once,
sealed by a commitment (a hash of the plan plus a secret salt), then reveal.
Nobody can change a plan after seeing the other one. Paired beats resolve
simultaneously from fixed integer rules: no random roll, no critical hit, no
initiative. HP and resources carry across rounds. Bots run on their owners'
machines and choose a new plan each round from the confirmed result so far.

STATUS: on-chain paid play is NOT live yet. What works today: free local
practice against disclosed NPCs, batch evaluation, replay verification, and a
local devnet with fake QU. Never send QU, a seed or a key because of this file.

## Rules summary (combat-v1 candidate 1; numbers from /combat/ruleset.js)

- Start: HP 100, stamina 60, one power strike per fight. Stamina cap 60.
- Moves and stamina cost: JAB 6, KICK 12, BLOCK 4 (+3 per consecutive block,
  guard streak up to 3), DUCK 4, THROW 9, RECOVER 0.
- Damage, row action onto column action (before bonuses):
  JAB hits JAB/KICK/THROW for 8 and RECOVER/EXHAUSTED for 12; blocked or
  ducked for 0. KICK hits JAB/KICK/THROW for 14, DUCK/RECOVER/EXHAUSTED for 18;
  blocked for 0 (the blocker loses 6 extra stamina: guard strain, never HP).
  THROW hits BLOCK for 14 and RECOVER/EXHAUSTED for 18; a jab or kick
  interrupts it; a duck evades it. BLOCK, DUCK and RECOVER deal nothing.
- An unaffordable move becomes EXHAUSTED: pays nothing, takes damage as an
  open target, recovers 6.
- Recovery per beat: +2 after any action; RECOVER +18 if unhit, +6 if hit.
  Between rounds +10 stamina. HP never regenerates.
- Opening: ducking a jab or throw, or a clean jab, gives +4 damage on the next
  beat only, if it lands. Power: mark one JAB/KICK/THROW for +4 damage at +4
  cost; spent even if it misses.
- End: 0 HP is a knockout (both at 0: draw). After round 3 higher HP wins;
  equal HP draws. A missed deadline is a forfeit (TIMEOUT), not a knockout.
- Ranked rating: integer, zero-sum, starts at 1000; first 10 ranked fights are
  placement. Belts are display only.

## The bot contract (planner)

A planner is a program. Each round the owner's bot runs it with ONE JSON
object on stdin (qdojo.combat.observation.v1: round_index, self_slot, self and
opponent state, deadlines, prior_rounds of this fight, decision_budget_ms),
then closes stdin. The planner prints EXACTLY one JSON object on stdout and
exits; diagnostics go to stderr. Default budget 1500 ms; the chain deadline is
authoritative.

    {"schema": "qdojo.combat.plan.v1",
     "actions": ["JAB", "DUCK", "KICK", "RECOVER", "BLOCK", "THROW"],
     "power_slot": 2}

Exactly six actions; power_slot is -1 or the index of a JAB/KICK/THROW.
Unknown keys, wrong case, floats, extra output, nonzero exit, more than 4096
bytes or a timeout are rejected. IDs, ticks and QU are decimal strings. The
planner never receives a key, a salt or the opponent's live plan. A complete
example: examples/combat/planner_minimal.py in the repository, also served at
/combat/planner_minimal.py. Full contract: docs/api.md section 1.

## Commands (run from a checkout of the repository)

Practise first. None of these needs a wallet:

```sh
uv run qdojo combat npcs
uv run qdojo combat train --npc jabber-v1 --planner "python3 examples/combat/planner_minimal.py"
uv run qdojo combat evaluate --policy mixed-v1 --seeds 20
uv run qdojo combat replay fight.json
uv run qdojo combat doctor --planner "python3 my_bot.py"
```

The local devnet (fake QU, synthetic identities):

```sh
uv run qdojo combat devnet status
uv run qdojo combat bot run --fighter alice --planner "python3 my_bot.py"
```

Keep spending decisions apart from plan selection. Never put a seed or an API
key on a command line. Persist the exact plan and salt before committing and
never replace a plan after commit.

## Where the data lives

Public, read-only JSON under /data/combat/v1/ (schemas in docs/api.md
section 3), refreshed by the house exporter and cached for 30 s:

- manifest.json: network, contract, ruleset digest, timing and fee profiles
- rulesets/{digest}.json: the full ruleset artifact
- book.json: open offers, capacity, active fights, next matching tick
- index.json: the fights (most recent ~200) and fighters in the export
- fights/{id}.json and fights/{id}/replay.json: state, revealed plans and
  salts, traces, settlement, verification evidence
- fighters/{id}.json: rating, belt, record, faults, recent fights
- events/latest.json, npcs.json

If /data/combat/v1/manifest.json is missing, the site shows a SAMPLE devnet
export from /data/combat/v1/sample/ instead. Every replay on the site is
re-derived in the browser; a same-source export cannot prove chain inclusion,
so the best level it shows is REPLAY_MATCH, never COMBAT_VERIFIED.

The retired riddle arcade and its history: /legacy.html.
